Annonce.label: Petites Annonces
Annonce.schema: CREATE TABLE annonces (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, slug VARCHAR(255), category VARCHAR(100), price_label VARCHAR(100), location VARCHAR(150), item_condition VARCHAR(80), image VARCHAR(255), description TEXT, contact_info VARCHAR(255), status VARCHAR(30) DEFAULT 'available', is_featured TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0, created_at DATETIME, updated_at DATETIME)

AnnonceReservation.label: Réservations d'annonces
AnnonceReservation.schema: CREATE TABLE annonces_reservations (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, annonce_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, annonce_title VARCHAR(255), requester_name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL, requester_email VARCHAR(180) NOT NULL, requester_phone VARCHAR(50), message TEXT, status VARCHAR(30) DEFAULT 'pending', created_at DATETIME)
